skills.name: Fleeting Fragrance
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Argenti's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: Justice, Hereby Blooms
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Argenti's ATK to all enemies.

skills.name: For In This Garden, Supreme Beauty Bestows
skills.desc: Consumes #2[i] Energy and deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Argenti's ATK to all enemies.

skills.name: Merit Bestowed in "My" Garden
skills.desc: Consumes #4[i] Energy and deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Argenti's ATK to all enemies. And further deals DMG for #2[i] extra time(s), with each time dealing Physical DMG equal to #3[i]% of Argenti's ATK to a random enemy.

skills.name: Sublime Object
skills.desc: For every enemy hit when Argenti uses his Basic Attack, Skill, or Ultimate, regenerates Argenti's Energy by #1[i], and grants him a stack of Apotheosis, increasing his CRIT Rate by #2[f1]%. This effect can stack up to #3[i] time(s).

skills.name: Manifesto of Purest Virtue
skills.desc:
After using the Technique, enemies in a set area are inflicted with Daze for #1[i] second(s). Dazed enemies will not actively attack the team.
When attacking a Dazed enemy to enter combat, deals Physical DMG to all enemies equal to #2[i]% of Argenti's ATK and regenerates his Energy by #3[i].

passives.name: Piety
passives.desc: At the start of a turn, immediately gains 1 stack(s) of Apotheosis.

passives.name: Generosity
passives.desc: When enemy targets enter combat, immediately regenerates 2 Energy for self.

passives.name: Courage
passives.desc: Deals 15% more DMG to enemies whose HP percentage is 50% or less.
